paite: Ka unaute aw, I Toupa Jesu Kris, Thupina Toupa gingta kawmin, mi khentuam neikei un,
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.

paite: Na kikhopna in uah mi dangkaeng zungbuh bun, puan hoih tak silh honglut leh, huan, mi genthei puan se tak silh honglut samta leh;
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue or, meeting , and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;

paite: huchiin, puan hoih tak silhmi tuh na limsak ua, a kiangah, Nang hiai mun hoih ah tuin, na chi ua, mi genthei kiang abel, Nang jaw huaiah ding inla, a hih keileh, ka khe ngakna nuaiah tuin, na chih uleh,
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, “Sit here in a good place”; and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”;

paite: na lungsim uah khentuam neia ngaihtuahna gilou pu, gense mite na hong hi kei ding ua hia?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

paite: Ka unau deihtakte aw, Pathianin hiai khovela gentheite ginnaa hau ding leh, amah itte kianga achiam gam luah ding khawng bangin a chi kei ahia?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

paite: Nou bel migentheite bang na zahlaksak zota ua. Mihaute hilou uhia nou honnuaisiah? Mihaute hilou uhia vaihawmna ina nou honkailut?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

paite: Amaute hilou uhia min manpha na put uh gensete?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

paite: Himahleh laisiangthouin, Nangmah na kiit bangin na vengte na it ding ahi, chih kumpi dan na zop uleh, na hih hoih uh;
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” Leviticus 19:18 you do well.

paite: Himahleh mi khentuam na neih uleh, na hih khial uhi, danin talekte na hih uh a honthei sak ngala.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

paite: Kuapeuhin dan jui kim mahleh, munkhata a hihkhelh ngalin tuh, a vekah siamlouhtangin a om khinta ahi.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

paite: Angkawm ken, chipan, Tualthat ken, a chi laingala. Huchiin angkawm keimah lechin tual na thah ngalin tuh, dana talekpa na hita himhim ahi.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” Exodus 20:14; Deuteronomy 5:18 also said, “Do not commit murder.” Exodus 10:13; Deuteronomy 5:17 Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

paite: Huaijiakin noplenna dana vaihawm sakdingte bangin thugen unla, thil hih belap un.
english: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.

paite: Mi tunga chitna neilou tuh chitna pang louin vaihawm a zou nak ahi.
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

paite: Ka unauate aw, min ginna ka nei chimahleh, thil hih aneihkei leh, bang a phatuam dia? Huchibang ginna in amah a hondam thei ding hia?
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

paite: Unaupa hiam, unau nu hiam, vuaktanga om in a niteng annek tasam le uh,
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

paite: Huchiin nalak ua kuahiam in a kiang ah, khamuang takin pai unla, lum tak leh vahtak in awm un chi unla, asa a ding a thil kiphamawh pe tuankei le uchin bang a phatuam dia?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace, be warmed and filled”; and yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

paite: Huchibangmahin ginna leng thilhih neiloua amah kiaa a om leh a si ahi.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

paite: Ahi, mi kuahiamin, Nang ginna na neia, ken thilhih ka nei ahi; na ginna tuh na thilhih panglouin hon ensak in huan ken ka thilhihin ka ginna ka hon ensak ding,
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.

paite: Pathian tuh khat ahi, na gingta maw? Na hih hoih e: dawiten leng a gingta ua, a ling zel uhi, a chi ding.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.

paite: Mi thulimlou aw, thilhih panglou a ginna lel bangmah ahi kei chih na thei nuam hia?
english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

paite: I pu Abrahamin a tapa Isaak maitam tung a alat laiin thilhih ziaka siamtang ahika hia?
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

paite: Ginna in a thilhih toh a sem khawm khawma, huan, thilhih ziakin ginna uh akimta chih I thei hi.
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;

paite: Huan, Abrahamin Pathian a gingtaa, huai ginna tuh a diktatna a sim ahi, chih Laisiangthou hihkim in a om a; huchiin mah tuh Pathian lawm chih in a om hi.
english: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness”; Genesis 15:6 and he was called the friend of God.

paite: Ginna ziak maimah hilou in, thilhih ziak zaw in, min siam a tang jel uh chih natheita uhi.
english: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.

paite: Huchibangmah in, Rahab kizuaknun leng sawltakte a nakipahpih a lam tuama a pai sak laiin, thilhih ziakin siam a tang ahi kei maw?Kha panglou in sa tuh si ahi, huchibangmahin thilhihte panglou in ginna leng si ahi.
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

paite: Kha panglou in sa tuh si ahi, huchibangmahin thilhihte panglou in ginna leng si ahi.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
